act.name: Family Courts Act, 1984
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law establishing Family Courts and promoting conciliation and speedy settlement of family disputes.

sections.title: Jurisdiction.
sections.text: Section 7 defines the jurisdiction of Family Courts over specified matrimonial and family proceedings.
sections.plain_language_summary: Identifies family disputes that may be heard by a Family Court.

sections.title: Duty of Family Court to make efforts for settlement.
sections.text: Section 9 requires Family Courts to make efforts toward settlement where appropriate.
sections.plain_language_summary: Family Courts should first try to help parties reach a settlement when possible.

sections.title: Right to legal representation.
sections.text: Section 13 regulates legal representation before a Family Court.
sections.plain_language_summary: Legal representation in Family Court is governed by the specific rule in this section.
